name: one-sentence
title: It Starts With One Sentence
html:
It Starts With One Sentence

The library renews three weeks at a time, and that was written into the code.

What I Wanted

The renewal period in a policy file, kept with the library’s code, so a pull request can change it.

What I Gave

One sentence, dictated. That’s the whole specification.

/remote-control

Let the library's renewal period come from its policy file, so a commit can change it. If the file doesn't say, keep three weeks.

Writing the scenario first.

Illustrative: the kind of sentence I dictate. The change itself is real, commit e3dbaca4, 11 November 2026.
say: Now, how it was built. Let's follow one real change, from start to finish. The library renews three weeks at a time, and that was written into the code. I wanted it in a policy file instead, kept with the library's code, so a pull request could change it. So I said one sentence, more or less this one, into my phone. That's the whole specification I gave. Everything that follows, Claude did, and the hooks made sure it did it in the right order.
